reason: Reduce the main engine reward from +2 to +0.5 per step to make it less dominant. Increase the hovering penalty from -0.5 to -2.0 to make hovering more costly. Make the descent reward conditional on both m_power>0 and vy<0 and increase its scale to 1.0. Add a small bonus (+0.1) for being near the pad (distance < 0.5) to encourage approach. Keep the success bonus at +200 but ensure it is only given when both legs contact, near pad, and low velocity. This should shift the policy from hovering to descending and landing.
preserved_design: progress-conditioned main engine reward (but with reduced scale)
changed_design: main engine reward: reduced from +2.0 to +0.5 per step when m_power>0 and distance decreases
hovering penalty: increased from -0.5 to -2.0 when |vy|<0.1 and distance not decreasing
descent reward: made conditional on m_power>0 and vy<0, scale increased from 0.5 to 1.0
added near-pad bonus: +0.1 when distance < 0.5 (to encourage approaching the pad)
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make main engine reward conditional on vy<0 alone (failed pattern from iter_002 to iter_003).
Do not reduce progress shaping strength (failed pattern from iter_000 to iter_001).
Do not add a reward for doing nothing (action 0).
Do not add a reward for orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) unless necessary.
Do not use a constant positive reward for main engine use that is independent of progress.
